pages.text: $(thing)Abyss$() adds a dimension that is almost entirely deep water. Its sea level sits around block 1000 in a world 1216 blocks tall, under a permanent night sky, with a mud floor far below the surface. It is built to be explored by submarine.

The mod plugs straight into $(l:ocean/submarines)Deep Seas$(/l): it hooks the Barometer and the ship pressure system. Its structures are sea bases and wrecked submarines. I found no portal item; the mod gives operators the commands $(item)/abyss teleport$() and $(item)/abyss exit$().

pages.title: Abysstone
pages.text: The mod's building stone. Reinforce it for tougher variants.

pages.title: Reinforced Abysstone
pages.text: Crafted from Abysstone. It is the main ingredient of the Abyssal Pressurizer.

pages.title: Abyssal Pressurizer
pages.text: Diamonds, Reinforced Abysstone and a Nether Star. On a Deep Seas ship it multiplies max hull depth by 10.

pages.title: Bulkhead
pages.text: A sealed door for ship interiors. Sneak-use to flip which way it opens.

Deep Seas ships its own $(thing)Create Abyss$() content too: a second Abyss dimension (a config option), plus Creepvine, Submarine Liana and fish such as the Amphistium and Cookiecutter Shark. Spawn eggs for them exist.

See $(l:ocean/hulls_and_pressure)Hulls and Pressure$(/l) before diving: at that depth only an Abyssal Pressurizer keeps a normal hull alive. Other deep places: $(l:ocean/underwater_places)Underwater Places$(/l).
